amendments.title: Punjab Land Records Authority Act 2017 (VI of 2017)
West Pakistan Land Revenue (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975 (XXVII of 1975)
West Pakistan Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970 (X of 1970)
West Pakistan Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969 (XXXIV of 1969)

notes: The 81-page PDF opens with the contents for the Punjab Land-Revenue Act, 1967 (XVII of 1967). The text begins on PDF page 11 and is dated 7 December 1967. Section 1 gives the short title as the Punjab Land-Revenue Act, 1967, extends it to the whole Province of the Punjab, and provides for commencement by government notification. A footnote records commencement on 1 January 1968. Chapter VI covers records-of-rights and mutations, including sections 39, 42 and 42-A. Chapter XIII covers appeals, review and revision, including sections 161–164. The text incorporates Act XLII of 2026, published on 21 May 2026, including the removal of the Tribal Areas exception in section 1(2). The PDF gives no express consolidation cutoff. Historical instruments are drawn from the PDF footnotes.

act_title: PUNJAB ENFORCEMENT OF WOMEN'S PROPERTY RIGHTS ACT 2021
notes: Punjab Code lists both the Act and the Ordinance. The four-page Act PDF opens with a contents page identifying Act X of 2021, with the text dated 17 May 2021 on PDF page 2. Its purpose is to protect women's ownership and possession of property. Section 1 gives the short title as the Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act 2021, extends it throughout Punjab, and provides for immediate commencement. Section 13 on PDF page 4 expressly repeals the Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Ordinance 2021 (IX of 2021). No subsequent amendment was identified on Punjab Code, and the PDF gives no consolidation cutoff.

Indian Limitation and Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1920 (XXVI of 1920)
Second Repealing and Amending Act, 1914 (XVII of 1914)

notes: Pakistan Code's federal detail page directly links the 47-page PDF. The first two pages contain the contents. PDF page 3 identifies Act IX of 1908, dated 7 August 1908, and describes limitation for suits, appeals and certain court applications. Section 1 gives the short title as the Limitation Act, 1908 and states that it extends to the whole of Pakistan. Sections 1 and 31 commenced immediately and the remainder on 1 January 1909. First Schedule article 150 on PDF page 39 shows 30 days and cites the 2023 amendment. Historical instruments are drawn from the PDF footnotes. The PDF gives no express consolidation cutoff. Pakistan Code's chronological listing marks the federal Act Under Review.
